artifact: §13 — consensus rule, FROZEN BEFORE ANY REVIEWER RESULT IS SEEN OR IMPORTED
statementOfOrder: This file was written before any reviewer response existed. No result has been observed. The rule cannot be adjusted after the fact.
majorityRule: 2-of-3 over the FULL state set. Surfacing states are NOT collapsed to the binary before the majority is taken.
threeWaySplit: If all three reviewers choose three different surfacing states, the case is NO_CONSENSUS. It is never collapsed to whichever state is closest to something.

abstainHandling.2 substantive + 1 ABSTAIN: the two substantive votes must agree; if they differ the case is NO_CONSENSUS

noConsensusHandling.inclusion: NO_CONSENSUS cases REMAIN in the denominator and are reported as their own category. They are not dropped, and dropping them would be a goalpost move under §40.
noConsensusHandling.agreementMetrics: inter-reviewer agreement is computed pairwise over cases where both members of the pair voted substantively; the per-pair denominator is reported alongside every rate.
noConsensusHandling.evaluatorVsConsensus: a NO_CONSENSUS case counts as a non-match for the evaluator, because no consensus exists for it to match.

binaryProjectionForLegacyComparison: Where a legacy binary comparison is required, FULLY_SURFACED maps to SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED and PARTIALLY_SURFACED maps to NOT_SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED, per the V3.1 contract. The full-state consensus is always reported too.

thresholds.unchanged: these are the pre-registered V3 thresholds, carried forward unchanged (§14, §40). They are not lowered.

denominators.surfacing: every case whose consensus credit decision is NO_CREDIT
denominators.note: the surfacing denominator is computed from the REVIEWERS' consensus credit decision, not from the evaluator's, so the evaluator cannot influence its own denominator.
